headline: DONKEY KONG: barrels take ladders out of thin air
lede: The arcade's end-of-girder ladders now stand at the fall-gap corner, and a falling barrel that meets one mid-descent rolls down it — a rule the repo could not have shipped before, because a silent physics bug meant no barrel in the sim was ever actually falling.

notes.text: #3622 shipped (PR #3627, 5bb797d): girder-end ladder pair at x=222 — R1 dangles its foot into girder 1's end-gap, R2 hangs off the corner to the ground. Corner-miss barrels meet them mid-air at BARREL_DIVE_CHANCE, once per barrel per ladder, no loops.

Root cause of the old 'unreachable' measurement: the edge check `!onPlat && vy===0` could never fire — gravity is already past vy>0 the tick support is lost. No airborne barrel state existed at all. Fixed to vy>=0; kongcheck now pins the mid-air floors exactly so the bug can never return silently.
Rebased cleanly onto slot a's half-rungs the same hour — both DK mechanics coexist; 122/0 kongcheck, 14/14 kongdrive, static green via the check-runs API (#3269 fallback after a dropped event).
QA handed #3641: corner sounds, double-board arcade rule, left-column symmetry, brace legibility on phones.

look.text: Miss the x=180 dive and watch a barrel catch the outside ladder off the tip
